subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Launched in 1975, this flagship Government of India programme delivers supplementary nutrition, pre-school non-formal education, immunisation, health check-ups, and referral services to children below 6 years and their mothers, through village-level centres. This programme is the:

options.option_text: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS), delivered via Anganwadi Centres

explanation: ICDS (1975), delivered through Anganwadi Centres, is India's principal early-childhood care programme covering ages 0-6 and pregnant/lactating mothers — distinct from Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (formal elementary schooling, ages 6-14) and PM POSHAN (school-going children's nutrition).
